refinement.reason: Source peer identified that CPython subprocess.run may signal its own child when communicate raises. Replace only capture with explicit Popen/communicate and same-handle drain/wait, without kill or terminate.

exact_reversible_helper_replacement.before:

    require(command[0] in TOOLS.values(), "unexpected executable")
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=REPO, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)

exact_reversible_helper_replacement.after:
def capture(command):
    require(command[0] in TOOLS.values(), "unexpected executable")
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=REPO, env=ENV, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate()
    except BaseException:
        try:
            process.communicate()
        finally:
            process.wait()
        raise
    process.wait()
    result = subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, process.returncode, stdout, stderr)
    require(len(result.stdout) <= MAX_PROLOGUE_OUTPUT, "bounded command output exceeded")
    require(len(result.stderr) <= MAX_PROLOGUE_OUTPUT, "bounded command stderr exceeded")
    return result
